items.title: Pay invoice DB-26-0117 (wedding invitations)
items.quote: Den Rechnungsbetrag überweisen Sie bitte binnen 14 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Invoice date 26.01.2026. Under § 187 (1) BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the period starts 27.01.2026. 14 days end at the end of 09.02.2026 (§ 188 (1) BGB), which is a Monday and not a holiday, so there is no shift. The letter also prints 'Zahlbar bis: 16.02.2026', which contradicts the 14-day period (it would be 21 days). I use the earlier date, 09.02.2026.

warnings: The letter contradicts itself: 'binnen 14 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum' gives 09.02.2026, but 'Zahlbar bis: 16.02.2026' is printed. The earlier date is used. Pay by 09.02.2026 to be safe, or ask the sender which date applies.
